create_DistributedPipelineRecord: create a DistributedPipelineRecord to store micro-batches as input to a single pipeline partition
feed_DistributedPipelineRecord: feed individual tensors of a given chunk into a DistributedPipelineRecord remotely via RPC
run_partition_pipeline: run pipeline parallelism on a PartitionHandler by processing all micro-batches through the partition module
compute_partition_chunk: compute forward pass for a single micro-batch chunk with optional activation checkpointing support
make_pipeline_record: make a DistributedPipelineRecord from a PartitionHandler with specified downstream consumer partitions
